Android notification access covers all notifications. Sakshi filters your chosen apps before reading message text. Unsaved previews clear when the vault locks, unless you also allow background observation. Turning this off or revoking access always clears them. It does not read chat history, outgoing messages, hidden content or View Once media.
Enter a valid Android package name.
Notification previews require Android 11 or later
No previews does not mean no harassment. Apps can hide or omit content, and notifications can be missed.

Background observation is a separate consent. Unsaved drafts stay in memory only, never on disk, and clear when the screen turns off, the device locks, the process ends, observation is turned off or access is revoked. Android and source apps may still omit previews.

Alerts use an unreviewed demonstration phrase list, not a threat prediction. Matches can misread quotes, negation or context. Alerts show no message text, sender or category. Android asks for notification permission only when you turn this on.
Notification permission was denied. Review alerts stay off; you can still review previews here.
